description: Oznámení komunikační činnosti is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Digitální a informační agentura. Electronic communications services provided by an electronic communications entrepreneur. Coverage: the Czech Republic. The portal shows the English title as "Notification of communication activities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Digitální a informační agentura. Its keywords include oznámení, služby elektronických komunikací, elektronické komunikace. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
